review.brief_reason: Both are total polynomials on R^5 (identical domain). Expanding the proposed factorization reproduces the original exactly: the five x_i^2*(a - p*x_i + q*x_i^2) blocks give the x_i^2/x_i^3/x_i^4 sums; the four x_i*x_{i+1}*(A - B*x_i - C*x_{i+1} + D*x_i*x_{i+1}) blocks give the x_i x_{i+1}, x_i^2 x_{i+1}, x_i x_{i+1}^2, and x_i^2 x_{i+1}^2 sums with B/C correctly assigned; the tail -x2x3*(E x1 + E x4 + F x1 x4 + F x4 x5) - E x3x4x5 yields exactly the three triple and two quadruple terms. All coefficients are literal-identical, variables x1..x5 and operator semantics are unchanged, and the monomial support (36 terms + constant) is the same, so this is a pure refactorization of equal complexity.
